verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a billing platform, since self-hostable billing systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Billing can be deployed on user infrastructure. The docs describe only Stripe-hosted Dashboard, API, invoice and portal features, and a user building their own billing system is a workaround, not product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
